description: This file contains Django signal handlers related to user preferences, search indexing, and cache invalidation for the cookbook application.

methods.name: skip_signal
methods.description: Decorator to prevent recursive signal calls by setting 'skip_signal' attribute.

methods.name: create_user_preference
methods.description: Signal handler to create UserPreference when a new User is created.

methods.name: create_search_preference
methods.description: Signal handler to initialize search fields in SearchPreference upon creation.

methods.name: update_recipe_search_vector
methods.description: Updates search vector fields for Recipe instances when saved, unless using SQLite.

methods.name: update_step_search_vector
methods.description: Updates search vector for Step instances when saved, unless using SQLite.

methods.name: update_food_inheritance
methods.description: Handles inheritance of fields for Food instances and cascades changes to children.

methods.name: clear_unit_cache
methods.description: Clears cache related to Unit model upon save.

methods.name: clear_property_type_cache
methods.description: Clears cache related to PropertyType model upon save.
